item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine and very hot weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers. With the anticyclone aloft weakening early to midweek next week, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the central part of the South China Sea in the latter part of next week.
